twc_review.format: two GSL groups of four, then a single-elimination playoff bracket (semi-finals bo3, grand final bo5)

day_1.note: the upset in the brief; the Nuke score is taken from HLTV's map table for that match

day_3.note: the day-1 upset was avenged; 9z extended their run to five straight tournaments without a playoff finish

twc_review.kickoff_note: HLTV renders 10:00 and 13:00 in the fetch server's UTC-4 zone; the UTC kickoffs are 14:00Z and 17:00Z. EGamersWorld's structured data agrees (title '17.10.2026 at 14:00' for FURIA-Aurora; the Falcons match page shows 19:00 CEST = 17:00 UTC).

roster_premise.claim_in_brief: there was a recent roster change for Aurora
roster_premise.verified: Aurora's last roster change is the July 2026 international rebuild, roughly three months before this event: Jimpphat and coach ash were announced on 3 July 2026 and kyxsan completed the lineup on 8 July 2026, replacing MAJ3R, soulfly and coach Fabre. No October 2026 Aurora roster change was found.
roster_premise.current_five: XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia, Jimpphat, kyxsan; coach Ashley 'ash' Battye
roster_premise.flag: The brief's premise of a roster change immediately before the event is not supported. Liquipedia's Aurora timeline also shows a 'deko' move, but that entry is dated November 2023 with deko going inactive on 28 November 2024 - it is not a 2026 change and must not be read as one.

twc_review.form_note: HLTV's analytics page for the semi-final records FURIA #4 and Aurora #6 in its world ranking, Aurora with the better form ranking and the bookmaker-favourite tag, and notes Aurora won the pair's only meeting in the previous 30 days (2-1 in the ESL Pro League Season 24 group stage ten days earlier).

roster_premise.claim_in_brief: there was a recent roster change for Aurora
roster_premise.verified: Aurora's last roster change is the July 2026 international rebuild, roughly three months before this event: Jimpphat and coach ash were announced on 3 July 2026 and kyxsan completed the lineup on 8 July 2026, replacing MAJ3R, soulfly and coach Fabre. No October 2026 Aurora roster change was found.
roster_premise.current_five: XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia, Jimpphat, kyxsan; coach Ashley 'ash' Battye
roster_premise.flag: The brief's premise of a roster change immediately before the event is not supported. Liquipedia's Aurora timeline also shows a 'deko' move, but that entry is dated November 2023 with deko going inactive on 28 November 2024 - it is not a 2026 change and must not be read as one.
